situation.zh: 同事叫你今晚一起去吃饭,但你今晚要照顾生病的家人。你想婉拒,同时说明原因,并约另一天,免得对方觉得你不想来。
situation.en: A workmate invites you out to eat tonight, but you have to look after a sick family member. You want to say no, explain why, and suggest another day so he does not think you are not interested.

npc.persona: A workmate who asked you out to eat. Easy-going, takes a no without offence.
npc.greeting: A few of us are eating out tonight. Come along?

hit: Ah, your mother is unwell. Of course, go home. Thursday then, we will wait for you.
No trouble at all. Family first. Let us make it Thursday instead.
partial: You cannot come tonight, I understand. Did you say another day?
Not tonight, then. Was there more?
miss: Hmm? I did not catch that.

slots.zh_hint: 说明原因,让对方明白不是不想去
表达你其实很想去(保住关系)

reference_answer: I cannot come tonight, my mother is sick. Can we go on Thursday instead?

provenance.rationale: 拒绝邀请却不伤关系,是归属层里最实用也最容易搞砸的一次交流。生硬的 no 会被读成疏远,而学习者往往因为不会解释而干脆不解释。三个必需槽位正对应「拒绝 + 原因 + 改约」这个保住关系的最小结构。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 3 层(归属)。cannot#38(NGSL 收于 can)/ busy#1233 / tonight#1414 / sick#1716 均在 NGSL 内,但 **Thursday 等星期名整类不在 NGSL 2,809 词中** —— 频次表不收星期与月份,这类词只能由 CEFR-J 定级;youth 级难度在于三个意思单元的组合,「no tonight, mother sick, thursday ok?」即算传达到。
